question: Does a simple daily trend filter tell when H4 trades in that direction pay? Tested both ways (long in uptrend, short in downtrend) so gold's rise cannot pass for information.
population: every complete H4 candle on data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv, both sides, same entry/stop/1.5R target/costs/funding as the replica (no candle-shape filter; range_study found none)

trend_definitions.T1_sma50: last completed broker-day close above (up) / below (down) the mean of the last 50 completed daily closes
trend_definitions.T2_ret20: last completed daily close above (up) / below (down) the close 20 completed days earlier

causality: only daily candles that closed before the H4 signal candle closed

books.trend_both: long when trend up, short when trend down

pass_bar_per_definition: test: longs in uptrend beat all longs by more than one standard error
test: shorts in downtrend beat all shorts by more than one standard error
test: trend_both mean net R > 0 with at least 30 trades per side
multiple_testing: two definitions; a definition passes only if all three conditions hold
caveats: The test year's all-longs average (+0.038R) was printed in range_study; no trend split of it has been seen.
22 May - 6 Oct 2026 is not used: those months were looked at today.
